#!/bin/bash

# Install curl
apt-get update
apt-get install -y curl

# Install uv
curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/0.9.5/install.sh | sh

source $HOME/.local/bin/env

# Check if we're in a valid working directory
if [ "$PWD" = "/" ]; then
    echo "Error: No working directory set. Please set a WORKDIR in your Dockerfile before running this script."
    exit 1
fi

rawEvidence: Each qualification invocation writes full original stdout, stderr, CTRF, subprocess observations and exact replacement ledger in its external evidence directory. This durable record keeps statuses, output identities, public inputs and measurements.

missingAuthority.mechanism: Scratch copy of actual adapter sends original --ctrf output to a missing parent directory. Original pytest and reward branch execute unchanged; expected CTRF is absent.

pathQualification.sharedBackslashLimitation: Bun 1.4.0 realpath returns ENOENT for an existing backslash-named macOS directory. Shared capture was not verified through a backslash TMPDIR; the actual adapter grade was.
